verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch supports self-managed deployment (Docker quickstart, self-managed vs Elastic-managed options) which inherently lets a user pick any region/on-prem location for their data, but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of Elastic Cloud region/residency selection or data-sovereignty controls. missing for 10: explicit Elastic Cloud region-selection docs, data residency/compliance certifications, and any first-party statement on cross-region data controls.
